description: This PHP test class verifies the behavior of the FormatWithWorkStation class, specifically its getFormattedValue method, within the OrangeHRM maintenance access strategy plugin. It sets up test data, mocks necessary services, and asserts expected outputs for certain input values.

classes.name: FormatWithWorkStationTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that tests the getFormattedValue method of the FormatWithWorkStation class, ensuring correct formatted value retrieval based on input IDs.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixture by setting up test data, mocking services, and instantiating the FormatWithWorkStation object.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Asserts that getFormattedValue returns 'Organization' for input 1 and null for input 5, validating the method's correctness.
